<view class="*:not-first:mt-2">
      <label for="select-30-id">Timezone select</label>
      <select defaultValue="Europe/London">
        <select-trigger id="select-30-id">
          <select-value placeholder="Select timezone" />
        </select-trigger>
        <select-content>
          
            <select-item key=Europe/London value=Europe/London>
              (GMT+0) Europe/London
            </select-item>
          

            <select-item key=America/New_York value=America/New_York>
              (GMT-4) America/New York
            </select-item>
          

            <select-item key=Asia/Shanghai value=Asia/Shanghai>
              (GMT+8) Asia/Shanghai
            </select-item>
          
        </select-content>
      </select>
    </view>
